name: Fell to Low
label: Revelation
lede: Fell to Low came out of Ojai loving Slint and Unwound, signed to Revelation, and made one album: six songs, mastered by Shellac's Bob Weston, ending on a three-part closer named for the stages of a Saturn V.

eras.title: Odd time signatures in Ojai
eras.text: Fell to Low started in Ojai, a small town inland from Ventura, playing hardcore with the odd timing of Slint, Unwound and June of 44. Two 7"s, two 10"s and a lot of West Coast dates with louder bands came first.

years.h: Ojai gets a band that counts in odd meters
years.p: Fell to Low start in 2009, and Revelation later describes the sound as smart, angular punk with odd timing, build-ups, melody and wit.
years.xp: Revelation's own line on the band: "Although not a household name, Fell To Low has been making noise since 2009." The label put them in the line that runs from Slint through Unwound and June of 44, with a hardcore approach.

years.cap: Fell to Low at Programme Skate, Aug 14, 2014
years.h: Two 7"s, two 10"s, then the whole country in 2012
years.p: Fell to Low had already toured the West Coast several times with [[Nails|a7d9c5f6-751d-4ea5-bf6d-39f1751d44a1]] and [[Give|55ffb0fe-e4e1-4674-b7b0-efd1e1fdf6d4]] before they covered the full US in 2012.
years.xp: It was a band with a back catalog of short records and no household name, which is how Revelation put it two years later.

eras.title: Revelation, and a rocket
eras.text: Revelation signed Fell to Low in 2014, a long way from the label's youth crew roots. The album came out in July 2015, followed by a short tour up the coast and into Canada.

years.cap: Fell to Low at Programme Skate, Aug 14, 2014
years.h: Revelation Records signs Fell to Low
years.p: Revelation announces a debut full-length from Travis Farmer, Shaine Scarminach, John Gianelli, Virgil Lawrence and Walker Delbo, whose members have played in Nails and Minus.
years.xp: IDIOTEQ's announcement is dated March 6, 2014. Revelation said the LP would build on the earlier records and push the band's sound further.

years.h: Noisey streams Low in the Dust before it's out
years.p: Vice's Noisey premieres the album ahead of release and calls it a six-track burner.
years.xp: Earsplit quotes Noisey saying each song progresses on its own, while the whole record gives "a sonic narrative that will crush and excite you."

yt: Saturn (I. S-IC, II. S-II, III. S-IVB), album audio
years.p: Six songs, mastered by Shellac's [[Bob Weston|7364260a-0a3e-4a6c-bcf8-b4e743c0b2c0]] at Chicago Mastering. The closer, Saturn, runs in three parts named for Saturn V stages: S-IC, S-II and S-IVB.
years.xp: Side A has four heavier, technical songs; side B has two long ones. The first pressing was 330 copies on 180-gram black vinyl and 546 clear, plus 11 test pressings.

years.cap: Fell to Low at Bottom of the Hill, San Francisco, Aug 11, 2014
years.h: Santa Barbara to Victoria and back in two weeks
years.p: The tour ends at Berzerktown Fest in Santa Ana, with dates alongside [[Iron Lung|6a757154-73e1-4981-9185-c180827fa527]], [[Destruction Unit|6bd87e31-0312-4199-bb61-4689b5794bb1]], Dawn of Humans and Green Beret.
